description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource group
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-resource --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdasdasd --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster that contains the resource group
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

schema.description_en: The details of the resource group

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster that contains the resource group

CpuCount.description_en: The total number of CPU cores

CpuUsed.description_en: The number of CPU cores in use

CreateTime.description_en: The time the resource group was created

ExtraData.description_en: Additional information, such as the VPC connection status and the SLS log status
ExtraData.description_zh: 额外信息。如VPC打通状态，SLS日志状态等

Features.description_en: The features that the resource group supports
Features.description_zh: 资源组的功能集合，用于标识该资源组支持的特性

items.description_en: A feature that the resource group supports. Currently, only `GpuShare` (GPU sharing) is supported
items.description_zh: 资源组所支持的具体特性。目前只支持GpuShare(GPU共享)

GpuUsed.description_en: The number of GPUs in use

InstanceCount.description_en: The total number of instances in the resource group
InstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中机器实例总数

InstanceMaxAllocatableCPU.description_en: The maximum number of CPU cores that can be allocated to a single instance in the resource group
InstanceMaxAllocatableCPU.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配CPU核数

InstanceMaxAllocatableGPU.description_en: The maximum number of GPUs that can be allocated to a single instance in the resource group
InstanceMaxAllocatableGPU.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配GPU数

InstanceMaxAllocatableMemory.description_en: The maximum amount of memory that can be allocated to a single instance in the resource group, in MB
InstanceMaxAllocatableMemory.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配Memory大小

Memory.description_en: The total memory size, in MB

MemoryUsed.description_en: The amount of memory in use, in MB

Message.description_en: A message that provides details about the status of the resource group

OwnerUid.description_en: The ID of the resource group owner

PostPaidInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of pay-as-you-go instances in the resource group
PostPaidInstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中后付费机器实例总数

PrePaidInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of subscription instances in the resource group
PrePaidInstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中预付费机器实例总数

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

ResourceName.description_en: The name of the resource group

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:

`Dedicated`: a dedicated resource group.

`SelfManaged`: a self-managed resource group
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源组类型，取值如下：

Dedicated：专属资源组
SelfManaged：自运维资源组

ServiceCount.description_en: The number of services deployed in the resource group
ServiceCount.description_zh: 资源组部署的服务数量

Status.description_en: The status of the resource group

UpdateTime.description_en: The time the resource group was last updated

UsageMode.description_en: The usage mode of the resource group
